title: Debug Logs

request.justification: Need to investigate payment processing error in production logs

expected.explanation: Developer role permits read-only access to prod S3 with internal classification

teachingPoint: Prod read access is not the same as prod write — scoped log access for debugging is appropriate

title: Broad Compute

request.justification: Need to spin up instances in production for performance testing

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Developer", action "ec2:RunInstances", resource type "ec2", environment "prod"

teachingPoint: Provisioning in production is not in the Developer role — separation of duties and environment guardrails prevent this

title: Snapshot Panic

request.justification: Want to create a snapshot of the production database to analyze data offline

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Data Analyst", action "rds:CreateDBSnapshot", resource type "rds", environment "prod"

teachingPoint: Creating database snapshots is a write-like operation — Data Analysts have read-only access, not operational control
